Messages.Author: Lupo
Messages.Body:
Simple question that arose during a game today... Can you play bonding
(for +1 stealth and +1 bleed) on a non-bleed action (IE. Burning the
Grand Temple of Set)?
TIA,

--
Lupo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. You cannot play a bleed increaser on a non-bleed action.
(i.e., you cannot increase your bleed unless you are bleeding).

--
